date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its own publication day; it describes the outage as happening on Tuesday 24 November.
title: TikTok outage hits users in the US and UK; company says a brief technical issue affected access
geo_basis: country: the article reports users in the US and UK
summary: IBTimes reports that TikTok users in the US and UK saw missing videos, broken feeds and "Something went wrong" errors on Tuesday 24 November. IBTimes says TikTok confirmed that a brief technical issue had affected access to its services. TikTok did not disclose a cause, and the article says it found no evidence the outage was a cyberattack.
plain: TikTok users in the US and UK saw errors and missing videos on 24 November. IBTimes says TikTok confirmed a brief technical issue affected access. No cause was given.
exec: IBTimes says TikTok confirmed a brief technical issue affected access; no cause was disclosed.

validation.note: One publisher (IBTimes UK) relaying TikTok's spokesperson statement; no TikTok or status page was read.

review.note: stronger than the source: IBTimes paraphrases TikTok (no verbatim quote), so removed quote marks and attributed to IBTimes
